mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operationLog ( account, operationType, operationDetail, createTime, updateTime, isDeleted ) VALUES ( #{account}, #{operationType}, #{operationDetail}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM operationLog WHERE createTime < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC
SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE operationType = #{operationType} AND isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC
SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE account = #{account} AND isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC

SELECT o.account AS account, u.name AS userName, COUNT(o.id) AS operationCount, MAX(o.createTime) AS lastOperationTime FROM operationLog o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.account = u.account WHERE o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY o.account, u.name ORDER BY operationCount DESC

SELECT o.operationType AS operationType, COUNT(o.id) AS count FROM operationLog o WHERE o.isDeleted = 0 AND o.createTime >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY o.operationType ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operationLog WHERE isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE operationType LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operationType}, '%') AND isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operationLog WHERE operationType LIKE CONCAT('%', #{operationType}, '%') AND isDeleted = 0
SELECT * FROM operationLog WHERE account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{account}, '%') AND isDeleted = 0 ORDER BY createTime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operationLog WHERE account LIKE CONCAT('%', #{account}, '%') AND isDeleted = 0
